reviews.title: Hell-vetic Airways
reviews.text: I had a misfortune of taking Helvetic Airways flights a few times over the past few months. Shame on Swiss for swapping their own planes/ crews with Helvetic, but still charging their outrageous monopolistic fares. None of these Helvetic flights departed on time, zero. Their planes are old narrow Embraers and the crews are clueless and impolite. Read the small print - if booking a Swiss Airlines flight you see a small print „operated by Helvetic Airways“, better cancel and book another flight. Not worth it - super poor price/ quality
reviews.author: maxve76

reviews.title: Short flight
reviews.text: Booked the flight via Swiss and ended up taking a place of Helvetic Airways. Never heard of this airline before but the journey is smooth and efficient. Seat is spacious enough for a short ride and arrival is ahead of schedule. Crew is polite.
reviews.author: Leonhkny

reviews.title: Very unfriendly, unhelpful staff
reviews.text: previous flight delayed and so had next to no time to get to the departure lounge to board Helvetic airlines flight. When I arrived at the departure gate the male member of staff wanted to see every single aspect of my boarding and ID documents and then pointed me to the female member of staff at the desk a mere 3 or so metres away. She informed me that I has missed the boarding slot and therefore I have missed the flight. I tried to tell her that the flight had only just landed and I had sprinted across the whole airport to try and get to this point and it was the same airline, she said that 'its not my (her) problem'. I was left to figure out where to go next and had to go back to the area I had come into the airport, past passport control again to find the transfer desk. That flight was also delayed sufficiently and I could have easily made it aboard but it felt like she was being bloody-minded. The transfer desk was 20 people deep on all sides with one member of staff working there. Staff lacked common sense and duty of care towards their passengers on a busy bank holiday weekend. Don't know what the aircraft is like inside because I never got the chance and given that due to their stance I ended up not getting home for quite some time, I don't really care. Keep your empty seat.

reviews.title: Good short flight between Zurich and Munich
reviews.text: We recently flew from Hong Kong to Munich, including a second-leg connecting flight from Zurich (ZRH) to Munich (MUC) with Helvetic Airlines. This was a short 35 minute regional flight on a Helvetic Embraer 190 model plane. At the departure gate in Zurich, we took the passenger mover vehicle directly to the plane which was awaiting on the tarmac. All passengers were aboard in 10-12 minutes and we were soon on our way to Munich. Flight was literally a departure, climb above the cloud lines before descending and landing into Munich shortly afterwards. seats were generally comfortable and there was sufficient legroom. Flight attendants served a quick round of drinks and chocolate before we landed. Luggage made its way to the carousel around 15 minutes after we arrived. Then we made our way out of the airport and into the city on the nearby S line. Overall, I would have preferred a direct flight from HKG to Munich but had no issues this short and seamless connection flight with Helvetic out of Zurich as part of our travel arrangements. Would be fine to fly with them again in the future.
reviews.author: Brad 🇭🇰

reviews.title: Bit of a trek in the bus to the plane
reviews.text: This is the 'sister' airline of Swiss Air, identical plane, but was delayed as plane 'not ready' when we had boarded the bus to the plane.....which was a good 10 minute trip from the terminal to the plane. Was a hot day, but we were kept on the bus until the plane had been 'readied', the bus driver was fine outside enjoying the weather, whilst the rest of the passengers slowly cooked.. Flight did not depart on time either, due to 'thunderstorms at BHX', but we did make up the time & arrived in BHX on time, no thunderstorms had happened, just presumed that the pilot had lost his time slot as the plane was not ready to be ready on time.

reviews.title: Worst seats ever
reviews.text: Modern day air travel might not be as comfortable as it once was unless you fly first class or business class or airlines with good economy seats such as Swiss and Emirates. Helvetic Airways, on the other hand, is the prime example of uncomfortable travel! Owned by Swiss, the airline was a disappointment as the seats were very uncomfortable. The leg room was tiny, the seats were hard and we were squashed by the person on the seat next to us. However, I can’t give them one star since the service on the plane was nice since the flight attendants were friendly.

The crew on both flights was very friendly and helpful. Comfort on board was ok and the snack was tasty (which cannot be said of other airlines). The first leg also was a bit delayed, but I had enough time for my connexion to Brussels in Zürich. In this way, I had the opportunity to have a glimpse of a really modern airport and to use the self-boarding gates.

reviews.title: good pilot
reviews.text: As we were going to land in Zurich, coming last week from Marseille, there was a sudden strong windgust from the side so that, as we were almost touching ground, there was a dangerous situation. The pilot mastered perfectly this risky moment by thrusting immediatly, without the slightest hesitation ( which could have been led to an accident ) the plane again into the air. We made a circle and then landed safely. All passengers applauded.

reviews.title: Not impressed.
reviews.text: Due to the length of the cabin, and only two cabin crew did the safety briefing, one at the front of the aircraft in Business, and the other behind me, I was unable to see. This surely contradicts airline regulations. I queried this with the senior cabin crew member and she categorically disputed there was a safety issue. As ex BA Cabin Crew, and I pointed this out to her, she still held her ground! Breakfast consisted of a bare croissant handed with a napkin with no butter, jam or cutlery, so I declined. In view of the cost of the fare, not impressed. I booked this flight on the Swiss website, not imagining that I would be flying with an inferior subsidiary.

reviews.title: Decent flight. Nothing more, nothing less
reviews.text: Traveled from Brussels to Zurich and back with this airline. The flight was booked at SWISS, but operated by Helvetic. The flight back was during the storm in January. Therefore the airplane left 15 minutes later. I don't think this is a big deal. As it is a short flight in economy class, you cant be to strict on giving a score. It is a short distance flight with no entertainment and with normal leg space. So what always counts for me is that the flight attendants are friendly and that the service is good. This all was the case so I don't have any complaints. I would choose this airline again.

reviews.title: Flight to Sion
reviews.text: A great innovation to be able to fly to Sion in the heart of the Valais. The airport is more convenient for many of the ski resorts than Geneva and cuts out much of the travelling time. the flight was delayed at Heathrow by nearly an hour and then we were in a holding pattern whilst a previous flight cleared from Sion. A bit surprising that a commercial aircraft would be held up for what was probably a private jet. It took us more than 30 minutes to get through passport control and we were not at the back of the queue. It was a good job the weather was mild as much of the queue was outside of the building. This flight can be really successful if it was to be more than just once a week and immigration is speeded up.

Going into Zurich they announce the gates for the connecting flights for people on board flying onwards from Zurich, something which many airlines do not do. E still get a croissant and coffee on the morning flight and a filled roll and coffee on the afternoon flights. Something many other airlines expect us to pay extra for

reviews.title: Zurich to Birmingham with great views
reviews.text: On my return trip I boarded a different F100 to Birmingham, this one looked newer. I was allocated seat 12a, which comes with an added bonus of a little hand pull called Emergency Exit - I was not worried - the stewardess explained what I would have to do and directed me and a german speaking lady on what we needed to do. In the event of a crash landing we would be opening the emenrgency exit on the wing. Note you have to be English or German speaking of sound mind and willing to become part of the air crew at that important moment, if it ever happened. Unlike my outbound flight the seatbelt fitted me and legroom was enormous. Flight was delayed due to a busy Zurich Airport, however 3 suitcases arrived just before take off (one was mine on Swiss Baggage Transfer from the resort a day previous). Take off was quick as we were 16 minutes late, slow left over Zurich and we were off. Meal was a sandwich and soft drink, duty free was available to those with CHF left. Just a light haze, we flew out over France, the Orient Forest and North of Paris and heading across the channel and Rye where we started our desent into Birmingham. viewed Gatwick and Heathrow, then over BHX and the M6 before turning and coming in from Walsall. Landing was soft but the nose wheel may have still been locked or full reverse came to quickly, I'm no expert and the flight crew seemed un interested.
